finding: The failed full-document requests returned HTTP 503 UNAVAILABLE ('model is currently experiencing high demand'), not 401/403 and not 429 quota errors. Healthy keys with AVAILABLE quota remain. The earlier one-token model probe succeeded, so the block is request/model capacity, not key validity or project quota. A smaller single-item context is the quota-conscious test.
selected_model_basis: It produced the successful C11 document response and the C5/C6 primary results; a single student page plus one scheme page is a much smaller request than the failed whole-document context. No new model probe is spent for this evidence run.
